items.q: Which method also protects against sexually transmitted infections?
items.qAf: Watter metode beskerm ook teen seksueel oordraagbare infeksies?
items.explain: Only barrier methods such as condoms reduce STI transmission.
items.explainAf: Net versperringsmetodes soos kondome verminder die oordrag van SOI’s.

items.q: An intrauterine device (IUD) works mainly by:
options: preventing fertilisation or implantation in the uterus
killing the ovum in the ovary
optionsAf: bevrugting of inplanting in die uterus te voorkom
die ovum in die ovarium dood te maak
items.explain: The IUD in the uterus prevents fertilisation or implantation.
items.explainAf: Die IUD in die uterus voorkom bevrugting of inplanting.

items.q: Why is the rhythm (calendar) method unreliable?
options: The timing of ovulation can vary
optionsAf: Die tyd van ovulasie kan wissel
items.explain: Ovulation does not always happen on the same day, and sperm survive several days.
items.explainAf: Ovulasie gebeur nie altyd op dieselfde dag nie, en sperme oorleef ’n paar dae.

items.q: The combined pill prevents pregnancy mainly because high levels of oestrogen and progesterone:
items.qAf: Die gekombineerde pil voorkom swangerskap hoofsaaklik omdat hoë vlakke estrogeen en progesteroon:
options: inhibit FSH and LH, so no ovum is released
optionsAf: FSH en LH inhibeer, dus word geen ovum vrygestel nie
items.explain: Negative feedback stops FSH and LH, so follicles do not mature and ovulation does not occur.
items.explainAf: Negatiewe terugvoer stop FSH en LH, dus word follikels nie ryp nie en ovulasie vind nie plaas nie.

options: the Fallopian tubes are cut and tied
optionsAf: word die Fallopiusbuise gesny en afgebind
items.explain: Cutting the oviducts stops the ovum and sperm from meeting.
items.explainAf: Om die eierleiers te sny, keer dat die ovum en sperm mekaar ontmoet.

items.q: In a vasectomy, the tubes that are cut are the:
items.qAf: By ’n vasektomie is die buise wat gesny word die:
items.explain: Cutting the sperm ducts means semen contains no sperm.
items.explainAf: Om die saadbuise te sny, beteken dat semen geen sperme bevat nie.
